breadcrumb: Std 6 Social Science Term-III (English) — Civics Unit 2: Local Bodies – Rural and Urban — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: The Government of Tamil Nadu will declare certain municipalities as corporations based on above Ten lakhs population and high revenue.

en.q: A municipality is declared a corporation in Tamil Nadu on the basis of ______.
options: a large population and high revenue
en.explanation: Avadi was declared a corporation on this basis (the book's list shows 21 corporations; more have been added since).

ta.explanation: ஆவடி இவ்வாறு அறிவிக்கப்பட்டது (நூலில் 21 மாநகராட்சிகள்; பின்னர் மேலும் சேர்ந்துள்ளன).

questions.quote: The urban local bodies are categorized into City Municipal Corporations, Municipalities and Town Panchayats, while the rural local bodies are categorised into Village Panchayats, Panchayat Unions and District Panchayats.

en.q: Which of the following is a rural local body?
en.explanation: Rural: Village Panchayat, Panchayat Union, District Panchayat. Urban: Corporation, Municipality, Town Panchayat.

ta.explanation: ஊரகம்: கிராம ஊராட்சி, ஊராட்சி ஒன்றியம், மாவட்ட ஊராட்சி; நகர்ப்புறம்: மாநகராட்சி, நகராட்சி, பேரூராட்சி.

questions.quote: A District Panchayat is formed in every district. A district is divided into wards on the basis of 50,000 population. The Mayor of the City Municipal Corporation and the Municipal Chairperson are the elected representatives of the people. The Corporation Deputy Mayor and the Municipal Vice Chairperson are elected by the ward councillors.

en.q: The Deputy Mayor of a Corporation is elected by the ______.
en.explanation: The Mayor and the Municipal Chairperson are elected by the people.

ta.explanation: மேயர், நகராட்சித் தலைவர் ஆகியோரை மக்கள் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கின்றனர்.

questions.quote: Obligatory Functions of the village Panchayat: Water supply, Street lighting, Cleaning roads, Drainage & sewage pipes system, Laying down roads. Discretionary Functions: parks, libraries, playgrounds, etc.

en.q: Which of the following is a discretionary function of a village panchayat?
en.explanation: Obligatory functions include water supply, street lighting, cleaning roads, drainage and laying roads.

ta.q: பின்வருவனவற்றுள் கிராம ஊராட்சியின் விருப்பப் பணி (discretionary) எது?
ta.explanation: குடிநீர், தெருவிளக்கு, சாலை, வடிகால் ஆகியவை கட்டாயப் பணிகள்.

questions.quote: Revenue of the Village Panchayat: House tax, Professional tax, Tax on shops, Water charges, Specific fees for property tax, Specific fees for transfer of immovable property, Funds from Central and State Governments.

en.q: Which of the following is a source of revenue of a village panchayat?
en.explanation: Water charges and professional tax are also sources.

ta.q: பின்வருவனவற்றுள் கிராம ஊராட்சியின் வருவாய் ஆதாரம் எது?
ta.explanation: குடிநீர்க் கட்டணம், தொழில் வரியும் வருவாய் ஆதாரங்கள்.

questions.quote: A Grama Sabha is formed in every Village Panchayat. It is the only permanent unit in the Panchayat Raj System. The Grama Sabha is the grass root level democratic institution in a Village Panchayat. Those who have attained the age of 18 years and whose names are found in the electoral roll of the same Panchayat can take part in a Grama Sabha meeting.

en.q: The only permanent unit in the Panchayat Raj System is the ______.
en.explanation: It is the grass-root level democratic institution in a village panchayat.

ta.q: ஊராட்சி ஆட்சி முறையின் ஒரே நிலையான அலகு ______.
ta.explanation: இது கிராம ஊராட்சியின் அடிமட்ட மக்களாட்சி நிறுவனம்.

questions.quote: Mahatma Gandhi advocated Panchayat Raj as the foundation of India's political system, where each village would be responsible for its own affairs. Special features of Panchayat Raj: Grama Sabha, Three tier local body governance, Reservations, Panchayat Elections, Tenure, Finance Commission, Account and Audit.

en.q: Who advocated Panchayat Raj as the foundation of India's political system?
en.explanation: Gandhi wanted each village to be responsible for its own affairs.

ta.q: இந்திய அரசியல் அமைப்பின் அடித்தளமாக ஊராட்சி ஆட்சியை வலியுறுத்தியவர் ______.
ta.explanation: ஒவ்வொரு கிராமமும் தன் தேவைகளுக்குத் தானே பொறுப்பேற்க வேண்டும் என்றார்.

questions.quote: The election to the Local Bodies is held once in five years by the State Election Commission. The Tamil Nadu State Election Commission is situated in Koyambedu, Chennai.

en.q: The elections to the local bodies are conducted by the ______.
en.explanation: The Tamil Nadu State Election Commission is situated in Koyambedu, Chennai.

ta.explanation: தமிழ்நாடு மாநிலத் தேர்தல் ஆணையம் சென்னை கோயம்பேட்டில் உள்ளது.
